title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next‑generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive‑level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short‑form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short‑form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low‑fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy‑only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb‑stop rate, 3‑second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI‑assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients.

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand‑holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy‑only with no hands‑on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

RINA is currently recruiting for a HSE Advisor - Occupational Safety Technician to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within the RINA Consulting QOHSE Division.

A Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Advisor typically plays a crucial role in supporting the HSE function within an organization. Compliance Monitoring:

Risk Assessment:

Training and Education:
- Support the development and delivery of HSE training programs for employees.

Incident Investigation:
- Participate in investigations of accidents, incidents, or near-misses to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences.

Communication:

Documentation and Record Keeping:
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records related to HSE activities.

Continuous Improvement:
- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in HSE processes and procedures.
- Stay informed about industry best practices and incorporate relevant updates into the HSE program.

description:
Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world‑class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users.

As an engineering manager you need both technical and management skills to lead your team. You will represent the team in direct partner engagement, ensuring stability and functionality that our cloud users expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU‑aided AI for servers, VMs, and containers.

As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring they grow as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. You will challenge and grow your team members with technical leadership and a solid background in software development. You will influence culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team builds. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high‑performing team.

Responsibilities
  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands‑on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events
Qualifications
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS
Benefits
  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Canonical by 2x.

description:
Somos a Rede Hospital Casa um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO que seja organizado, prestativo e que tenha uma comunicação assertiva em seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:
  • Aplicar os conhecimentos técnicos de Segurança do Trabalho de modo a reduzir, neutralizar ou eliminar os riscos à segurança do trabalhador;
  • Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigando riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores;
  • Inspecionar locais, instalações e equipamentos da empresa e determinar fatores de riscos de acidentes;
  • Realizar auditorias internas e treinamentos de Segurança do Trabalho em todos os Setores da unidade Hospitalar, de forma rotineira, identificando condições insalubres e perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como orientar e conscientizar os colaboradores quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho;
  • Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);
  • Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;
  • Acompanhar de forma permanente as atividades realizadas pela CIPA, estudando suas observações e propostas, visando a adoção das soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho e meio ambiente dela valendo-se como agente multiplicador;
  • Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI);
  • Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros;
  • Fazer inspeção em equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, recursos audiovisuais e didáticos e outros materiais considerados indispensáveis, de acordo com a legislação vigente;
  • Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes;
  • Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;
  • Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios;
  • Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis;
  • Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;
  • Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes;
  • Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas;
  • Dar suporte às perícias judiciais, à Medicina do trabalho conforme a deliberação da Coordenação do SESMT.
  • Acompanhar as atividades pela enfermagem, hotelaria, serviços de higiene e limpeza, nutrição, com objetivo de assegurar as normas legais internas em segurança do trabalho;
  • Participar de reuniões sobre segurança no trabalho, fornecendo dados relativos ao assunto, apresentando sugestões e analisando a viabilidade de medidas de segurança propostas, para aperfeiçoar o sistema existente;
  • Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática;
  • Executar e apoiar outras tarefas para o desenvolvimento das atividades do Setor, inerentes à sua Função;

Purpose
  • You are responsible for ensuring the effective integrity of piping systems and pressure vessels on Floating Production Storage and Offloading (FPSO) units.
Responsibilities
  • You act in the integrity on‑board FPSOs for Pressure systems (Piping, Pressure Vessel, hoses, and tubing).
  • You are responsible for the execution of the scopes for all equipment controlled, piping and pressure vessels in particular, including predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, quality assurance and quality control of subcontractors.
  • You ensure legal compliance, national regulatory requirements and keep certifications based on national or international standards and ordinances.
  • You ensure preparation, implementation, and monitoring of inspection plans of piping and pressure vessels controlled equipment, and organization of related activities with equipment inspector.
  • You define inspection techniques to guarantee the physical integrity of piping and pressure vessels. Implement new inspection technologies, and methodologies, special tests, engineering studies, etc.
  • You analyze the in‑service piping and pressure vessels structural integrity through inspections and nondestructive tests, assessment for fitness for service or risk‑based inspection to determine if the equipment is fit for continued service.
  • You embark in the operational units might be required for these activities to comply with local requirements.
  • You prepare, review, and approve inspection records, ensuring that are conclusive in accordance with the company procedures, standards, integrity management system, national legislation and ordinances, to attend certifications.
  • You approve, control, reassess and manage the inspection technical recommendations related to piping and pressure vessels inspections.
  • You support the frame agreement negotiations with subcontractors dealing with the activies in Piping and Pressure Vessel.
  • You collect KPIs to maintain the overall dashboard for Asset Integrity execution, inspection and monitoring.
  • You support the Asset Integrity Piping & Pressure Vessel specification for the new units.
  • You review annual inspection campaigns relative to the discipline.
Education
  • Bachelor Degree in Mechanical or Naval Engineering Disciplines, or equivalent.
Experience
  • Experience in the field inspection of piping and pressure vessels, following national and international standards and ordinances.
  • Extensive knowledge in design and Engineering as per process piping international standard (B31.3).
  • Extensive knowledge of pipe construction and piping repair techniques is a plus.
  • Extensive knowledge of Risk Based Inspection (RBI) methodology and standards is a plus.
  • Extensive knowledge in piping specification such as piping material class, material data sheet.
  • Design skill in Plant Desig Management System (PDMS) or Naviswork softwares.
  • Master degree or Post‑Graduation in a relevant subject to the activities (e.g. Metallurgical/Corrosion) or relevant certification in correlated areas is considered a competitive edge.
  • Be active with any mandatory registration and certifications required by national regulatory standards
Functional Competencies
  • Piping - Piping Materials Monitoring performance and compliance
  • Regulatory Management Inspection, testing, commissioning and monitoring
  • Learning from events
  • Piping - Stress and Supports
  • Piping - Risk Based Inspection
  • Internal Audit Delivery
  • Mechanical Static Equipment - Pressure Vessel Planning

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS
description:
Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho - SMS

Triunfo Logística

Descrição

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI’s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos físicos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
  • Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Registro MTE.
  • Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Jornada: escala 12x36 (diurno ou noturno)

title: Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica – e.Quality Soluções – Rio de Janeiro
description:
Cargo: Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica

Descrição

O Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica é o líder técnico e gestor das operações de engenharia clínica em sua unidade de atuação, assegurando a gestão segura, eficaz e economicamente responsável do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele garante a excelência na execução dos serviços, a conformidade com as regulamentações, a otimização dos recursos e o desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, atuando como um pilar fundamental para a satisfação do cliente e a qualidade do serviço.

Gestão Operacional e Conformidade
  • Assegurar a implementação e a manutenção contínua dos processos definidos no Plano de Gerenciamento de Tecnologias em Saúde (PGTS) da unidade, utilizando os sistemas e ferramentas designados.
  • Garantir a total conformidade das operações e documentações com a legislação vigente, normas técnicas (ex: NBR IEC 60601, ISO/IEC 17025 quando aplicável) e regulamentações (ANVISA, INMETRO).
  • Revisar e garantir a organização e controle de todos os documentos relacionados aos processos no sistema de gestão (ex: DOO), assegurando sua rastreabilidade e fácil acesso.
  • Preparar e organizar a documentação e processos referentes à acreditação hospitalar da unidade, montando apresentações para auditorias e liderando o processo para o sucesso da certificação.
Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe
  • Supervisionar e orientar diariamente as atividades dos técnicos de engenharia clínica, garantindo a qualidade e eficiência na execução dos serviços de manutenção, calibração e ensaios.
  • Acompanhar a performance individual e da equipe, provendo feedback construtivo e participando ativamente do desenvolvimento técnico dos colaboradores.
  • Garantir a replicação e adesão da equipe aos treinamentos ministrados pela empresa, bem como promover o compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico com a equipe e com o corpo assistencial do cliente.
Gestão da Manutenção e Otimização do Parque Tecnológico
  • Garantir a resolutividade das solicitações de manutenção corretiva, supervisionando o diagnóstico, a cotação de peças/acessórios e a proposição de soluções eficazes.
  • Supervisionar e acompanhar a execução da manutenção planejada (preventiva e preditiva) dos equipamentos, assegurando o cumprimento dos cronogramas e a emissão dos laudos e certificados.
  • Assegurar o correto preenchimento e registro de todas as atividades no sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), desde a abertura da solicitação até a avaliação do serviço prestado.
  • Elaborar pareceres técnicos e laudos de obsolescência de equipamentos, baseando-se no histórico e normativas, para subsidiar a avaliação do parque tecnológico do cliente.
Gestão de Fornecedores e Contratos
  • Supervisionar os serviços realizados por terceiros e a execução de contratos dentro da unidade, por meio da análise das ordens de serviço externas.
  • Avaliar o custo-benefício de contratos e serviços avulsos de terceiros, propondo otimizações ou alternativas.
  • Relacionar e controlar pedidos de materiais, acessórios e peças de reposição para garantir a eficiência e a continuidade do funcionamento dos Equipamentos Médico-Hospitalares (EMH), gerenciando o estoque no SGM.
Análise de Dados e Relatórios
  • Confeccionar relatórios técnicos detalhados de manutenções corretivas, preventivas, calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica.
  • Realizar análises críticas para apresentar ao cliente o status dos equipamentos, sugerindo soluções técnicas e economicamente viáveis para otimizar a gestão do parque tecnológico.
  • Manter o coordenador imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e desafios, buscando soluções e alinhando estratégias em reuniões e contatos diários.
Relacionamento com o Cliente e Expansão de Serviço
  • Atuar como ponto de contato técnico principal com a equipe e gestão do hospital cliente para assuntos relacionados à engenharia clínica.
  • Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações, conforme a necessidade do cliente, com o objetivo de ampliar o escopo de serviços e soluções oferecidas.
Gestão de Ativos e Recursos
  • Zelar pela conservação e organização de todos os equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, solicitando reposição quando necessário.
  • Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo, delegadas pelo coordenador de engenharia clínica ou superior imediato.

description:
Líder de Logística/ Gestão de pessoas/ Produção de logística/ Expedição/ Recebimento/ Produção de laboratório Farmacêutico

Se você procura boas oportunidades para sua carreira e deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e agradável, é comprometido com os resultados e tem brilho nos olhos, a FQM é o lugar certo para você!

O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua desde 1932 no Brasil e faz parte do Grupo multinacional Roemmers, com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina.

No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos e cosméticos, atua em dois segmentos: medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.

A FQM, com mais de 1.500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história por meio de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

Caso Você
  • Tenha facilidade de relacionamento com diferentes perfis;
  • Possua visão orientada a dados;
  • Tenha habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Tenha bom planejamento do tempo;
  • Tenha brilho nos olhos e seja protagonista da sua carreira... seu lugar é aqui!
QUAIS SERÃO AS SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES?
  • Realizar estudos de capacidade da fábrica, simulando cenários para propor táticas alinhadas com a estratégia da diretoria. Realizando análise do MFV, detecção de gargalos e criação de projetos de melhoria de ganho de capacidade e eliminação de desperdícios;
  • Calcular o ritmo das famílias produtivas da fábrica, assim como realizar o acompanhamento diário através do Heijunka;
  • Realizar o monitoramento do Sistema de Eficiência Geral do Equipamento (OEE), assim como realizar reuniões no gemba com equipes multidisciplinares, avaliando a eficiência do processo e estimulando melhorias contínuas;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas e dashboards que auxiliem o monitoramento e gestão dos Indicadores da Diretoria de Operações;
  • Atuar como agente de melhoria contínua, identificando gargalos, propondo ações e estratégias de mitigação de problemas de forma a garantir o atingimento dos resultados;
  • Liderar projetos de melhoria contínua (Kaizens) em times multidisciplinares;
  • Conduzir reuniões de performance de processo, prestando assistência na verificação da consistência dos relatórios gerados, compartilhando os resultados atingidos, analisando a avaliação do alcance das metas propostas e as investigações das causas / consequências dos problemas encontrados, a fim de contribuir com a promoção do aprimoramento contínuo dos processos e de utilização de recursos;
  • Disseminar e aplicar os conceitos da filosofia Lean Manufacturing através da ministração de treinamentos e capacitações.
PRÉ REQUISITOS
  • Formação em Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Química ou Farmácia.
  • Conhecimento em Lean Manufacturing
  • Pacote Office Avançado
  • Habilidade em comunicação e mediação de conflitos para atingimento de resultados
  • Atuação anterior em melhorias de processos produtivos na Indústria.
DESEJÁVEL

title: Sr. Clinical Operations Lead (LATAM)
description:
5 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Responsible for the clinical operations of a project within a defined regional/global level. Provides oversight of project deliverables, assigned Clinical Research Associate (CRAs) and Investigator sites in accordance with the Monitoring Plan, Protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and local regulations. The COL acts as a primary liaison between the CRAs and the clinical project team. Additional responsibilities include project specific training of CRAs, conducting assessment visits with CRAs, implementation of enrollment and recruitment strategies, preparation of the monitoring plan and other structural documentation and the oversight of monitoring visit scheduling, site and monitoring performance metrics, issue escalation and corrective actions. The COL will develop study tools for site and CRA use, review visit reports, review and track protocol deviations, and support other objectives for clinical operations and the clinical project team.

Project Oversight
  • Overall oversight of regional CRAs to ensure compliance with study protocol, study plans, ICH‑GCP, local regulations and study timelines
  • Monitoring support visits (Co‑monitoring), per project requirements, to aid the site/CRA in satisfactory performance and compliance with standards
  • May support clinical project team by providing oversight of study deliverables related to other departments (e.g. Data Management, TMF Operations, etc.)
  • Oversee regional startup and feasibility activities
  • Assist in vendor management activities as required per project
  • Perform review of visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management
  • Assure compliance with high quality and timely project deliverables according to the project requirements and the monitoring plan
  • Proactive management of site and country performance (recruitment, data collection, document collection, TMF review etc.) and inform clinical project team on progress
  • Contribute to financial project management processes as applicable (input on revenue recognition, site payments, site pass‑through expense review)
  • May be required to manage/oversee investigator sites including CRA responsibilities on a temporary or permanent basis
Project Liaison
  • Conduct regular global CRA calls with the monitoring and site management team, and individual/country CRA calls
  • Attend meetings with Study Sponsor to provide status updates on country and site progress
  • Provide operational support and guidance to the monitoring team throughout the project
  • Provide project training/mentoring to regional CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans & guidelines, and timelines for the study; ensures study specific training requirements are completed and documented
  • First point of contact for regional CRAs for study‑specific questions and issues; escalates to PM and other functions as appropriate
  • Support line managers by providing status updates on utilization and performance of CRAs
  • Liaise with line manager for assigning sites to CRAs following line manager allocation of a CRA resource to the project
  • Conduct CRA assessment visits per departmental requirements to assess performance against monitoring responsibilities
Study Documents and Plans
  • Develop training materials and study tools for sites and CRAs, including monitoring plans
  • Develop and implement enrolment and recruitment strategies together with clinical project team
  • Develop presentation materials for and present at Sponsor Kickoff meetings, Investigator meetings and Sponsor Calls (as needed); prepares presentations for Site Qualification Visits and Site Initiation Visits
Qualifications
  • College diploma/degree AND 7‑9 years related experience + continuous training and knowledge/skills upgrading
  • Undergraduate university degree (Bachelors or Honors Bachelors) AND 4‑6 years’ experience + substantial on‑going job‑related training
Other
  • Health Sciences, Life Sciences or Nursing specialty preferred, or SoCRA and/or ACRP Certification/Designation
  • Minimum of 3 years CRA experience; strong experience with EDC systems; proficient with MS Office; strong written and verbal communication skills; highly effective interpersonal and organizational skills
  • Demonstrate the following attributes: proactive, detail oriented, task‑driven and highly organized
  • Demonstrate the critical elements of GCPs and local regulations as they relate to clinical monitoring, IRB/EC and Investigator responsibilities
  • Demonstrated ability in report writing and strong ability to critically understand clinical research documents
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Fugro’s innovation teams are responsible for carrying out developments serving both internal users and Fugro clients. With Innovation centers in Canada, Brazil, USA, and other key locations around the world; you will be joining a global innovation group with a tradition of developing best‑of‑class applications in the Geo‑data space. Our engineers are experts in domains such as spatial data, cloud computing, deep learning, and process automation.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Fugro, you will be responsible for the development, maintenance and support of innovation software products, ensuring quality, timelines and cost‑effectiveness of innovation projects are achieved. Your work will comply with company standards and you will be actively contributing to the continuous improvement of the engineering process, by delivering safe and good‑quality software increments.

What You Will Do
  • Develop and maintain high‑quality software during their lifecycle.
  • Implement software projects using C# and Angular, or similar technologies.
  • Ensure regular communication with other developers and teams involved in the development process.
  • Deliver and recommend architectural solutions to the product.
  • Implement, test, and perform system and functionality corrections (bug fixes).
  • Act as a member throughout the delivery process of agile methodologies using Scrum.
  • Build and maintain efficient and reliable / stable source codes.
  • Collaborate with team members at all stages, from prototype, production and implementation / progress throughout the project.
  • Solve complex real‑world challenges effectively, efficiently and creatively.
  • Act as a quality keeper by documenting code, processes, architectural decisions, increasing code coverage continuously.

Please submit your resume/CV in English

What We Are Looking For
  • 8+ years of experience coding with C#, Angular, or similar.
  • Experience with API development.
  • Solid understanding of database concepts and SQL.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integration with test automation.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and GitHub.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
  • Excellent problem‑solving and analytical skills.
  • Actively integrate AI tools and techniques to accelerate development cycles and improve software quality.
  • At least Upper‑Intermediate level of spoken and written English.
Bonus Points
  • Cloud Certifications, preferably AWS
  • Familiarity with GitHub and GitHub Actions
  • Previous experience working with geospatial data.
How We Work

At Fugro, we believe in alignment, autonomy, and personal accountability throughout the product life cycle. Our collaborative work environment blends the flexibility of remote work with in‑office collaboration, fostering a culture built on trust.

About Fugro

Fugro is the world’s leading independent provider of geo‑intelligence and asset integrity solutions for large construction, infrastructure, and natural resources. We collect and analyze data about the Earth and the structures built upon it, providing comprehensive information and advice to our clients to help them make better decisions about their assets and projects. We rely on innovation to push the transition towards net‑zero carbon, safe infrastructure and climate resilience to deliver on our promise to create a safe and livable world.

Why would you join us?

International Geo‑data environment – We work for and with the entire world. The Earth is fascinating, as are the people on it. We work hard to create and maintain an inclusive culture. Challenging projects and exciting opportunities – We are ahead of the curve and have the best projects to work on. In addition, exciting opportunities arise around the world every day. Freedom to grow faster – If you are prepared to take the initiative, ample opportunities locally or worldwide await you at Fugro.

Fugro does not accept any unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies. Acquisition to Fugro Recruitment or any Fugro employee is not appreciated.

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

That role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI ́s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aquelesdanificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foiretirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao AuxiliarAdministrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação daintegridade física do colaborador;

  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc.,informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilhafeita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial osproblemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança doscolaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes,definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização daatividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física doscolaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentesnos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresaresponsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos,exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;

A Triunfo Logística oferece soluções competitivas em operação portuária e logística com altos padrões de qualidade, segurança, ética e respeito ao meio ambiente, buscando gerar valor para acionistas e sociedade. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection. As a company, we are owned by A.P. Moller Holding, operating independently with the trust and empowerment to do what is right for us, while proudly bearing the Maersk name and values.

What you’ll do

Your mission is simple yet powerful: attract and engage the best maritime talent while ensuring our offshore colleagues feel valued and supported .

You’ll lead initiatives that go beyond filling positions—creating meaningful connections and building trust with candidates and stakeholders. From crafting employer branding to managing end-to-end recruitment, you’ll ensure every interaction reflects our values.

Your key responsibilities will include:
  • Drive talent attraction strategies aligned with business goals.

  • Lead the Cadet Programme, supporting the next generation of seafarersli>

First and foremost, you are passionate about the maritime industry and enjoy building up trusted relationships, and you recognize the game-changing potential by working in crewing and the positive effect that you can bring to people’s life. In addition, we hope you can say yes to the following:

  • Strong decision-making, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience in lean organisations and proactive process improvement.
  • Makes quality decisions quickly and confidently, even in fast-paced environments.

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 30 November 2025. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

description:
HSE Advisor - Occupational Safety Technician

RINA is currently recruiting for a HSE Advisor - Occupational Safety Technician to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within the RINA Consulting QOHSE Division.

Mission

A Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Advisor typically plays a crucial role in supporting the HSE function within an organization. The role supports the application of the Corporate and Company policies, developing and implementing security policies, guidelines, procedures, and protocols for the security of Company assets, projects, and business travels.

Key Accountabilities
  • Compliance Monitoring: ensure that the organization complies with local, state, and federal health and safety regulations; monitor and track changes in regulations and update relevant stakeholders.
  • Risk Assessment: assist in conducting risk assessments to identify potential hazards in the workplace; collaborate with other departments to analyze and mitigate risks.
  • Training and Education: support the development and delivery of HSE training programs for employees; help create educational materials to promote awareness of health and safety issues.
  • Incident Investigation: participate in investigations of accidents, incidents, or near‑misses to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences; assist in the documentation of incidents and implementation of corrective actions.
  • Data Analysis: collect and analyze HSE data to identify trends and areas for improvement; prepare reports on HSE performance and make recommendations based on the analysis.
  • Emergency Response Planning: contribute to the development and testing of emergency response plans; assist in organizing drills and training exercises for emergency situations.
  • Inspections and Audits: support regular inspections and audits to ensure compliance with HSE policies and procedures; document findings and work with relevant teams to address any deficiencies.
  • Communication: assist in the communication of HSE policies and procedures to employees; participate in HSE meetings and collaborate with other departments to promote a culture of safety.
  • Documentation and Record Keeping: maintain accurate and up‑to‑date records related to HSE activities; assist in preparing documentation for regulatory agencies and internal audits.
  • Continuous Improvement: identify opportunities for continuous improvement in HSE processes and procedures; stay informed about industry best practices and incorporate relevant updates into the HSE program.
Qualifications
  • Technical degree in occupational safety is mandatory, along with registration with the Ministry of Labor and Employment. Bachelor's degree is a plus.
  • Good experience in HSE advisory roles, preferably in industrial or construction sectors.
  • Having certifications related to health and safety can enhance a candidate's profile, including ISO 45001.
  • Familiarity with local, state, and federal health and safety regulations is crucial.
  • Ability to analyze data and identify trends related to health, safety, and environmental performance.
  • Experience in conducting risk assessments, safety audits, and ensuring compliance with local and international standards.
  • Proficient in developing and delivering HSE training and awareness programs.
Competencies
  • CLIENT INTIMACY – Embrace internal and external client needs, expectations, and requirements to ensure maximum satisfaction.
  • EARN TRUST – Take everyone's opinion into account and remain open to diversity.
  • PROMOTE SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT – Promote commitment by keeping promises as a role model.
  • MANAGE EMOTIONS – Recognise one's and other's emotions and express and regulate one's reactions.
  • PIONEER CHANGE – Actively embrace change and benefit from the new circumstances.
  • BUILD NETWORK – Forge trust relationships, across departments, and outside the organization.
  • MAKE EFFECTIVE DECISIONS – Structure activities according to priorities, actions, resources, and constraints.
  • ADDRESS THE WAY – Have a big picture of different situations and reinterpret it in a perspective way.
  • THINK FORWARD – Capitalise on experiences and translate them into action plans for the future.

This professional must ensure that participants acquire the theoretical knowledge and practical skills required to operate safely in drilling and well control scenarios.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Ministrar aulas teóricas e práticas de Controle de Poço conforme o currículo oficial do IADC WellSharp.

  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas, contribuindo para a manutenção da acreditação do centro de treinamento.

  • Colaborar com a equipe de instrutores e suporte técnico no desenvolvimento e aprimoramento dos cursos.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Certificação: Instrutor aprovado pelo IADC WellSharp para ministrar cursos de Controle de Poço

  • Conhecimento Técnico: - Métodos de controle de poço (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading) - Pressões de formação, influxo, hidráulica de poço, operações de cimentação e revestimento - Normas e boas práticas internacionais (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP).

  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado (mandatório).

We are looking for

  • Certification: IADC WellSharp-approved Instructor authorized to deliver Well Control courses.

  • Technical Knowledge: - Well control methods (Driller’s Method, Wait & Weight, Volumetric, Bullheading) -Formation pressures, influx behavior, well hydraulics, casing, and cementing operations -International standards and best practices (IADC, IWCF, API, ANP).

Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50-100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. Accepted Locations and Languages

Loom Video
